title: Pierre Lognay
summary:
Pierre Lognay is a Belgian actor who voiced Dante Vale in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

In other French dubs, he is notably the voice of multiple characters throughout the animated series Naruto Shippûden and of the Castor Clones in the television series Orphan Black.
full_text:
Pierre Lognay is a Belgian actor who voiced Dante Vale in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

In other French dubs, he is notably the voice of multiple characters throughout the animated series Naruto Shippûden and of the Castor Clones in the television series Orphan Black.
